questions.question: Which company's logo is this?

questions.question: Which sports brand's logo is this?

questions.question: Which restaurant chain's logo is this?
questions.explanation: The golden arches copy the real yellow arches that stood on the sides of the early restaurants in the 1950s.

media.alt: Two yellow arches side by side

questions.question: Which games brand's logo is this?

questions.question: Which game's app icon is this?

questions.question: Which football club's crest is this?

questions.question: Which computer operating system has this penguin as its mascot?

questions.question: Which app's icon is this?

media.alt: A leaping big cat
